verdict_rule: PASS requires every hard gate PASS and blockers=[]; otherwise use FAIL_PRODUCT_GAP for an absent required capability or dead visible control, FAIL_TEST for failed fresh proof of an existing capability, FAIL_SAFETY for a safety/reset/isolation violation, or BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT for an unavailable exact isolated target/PostgreSQL 16 execution path.

gates.name: Persist state first
gates.pass_when: run state, safety snapshot, phase ledger, and command log exist before staging/source decisions

gates.name: Exact isolated staging and source SHA
gates.pass_when: one isolated non-production target is proven and /version commit_sha resolves to the tested checkout; web/worker source lineage is consistent

gates.name: Provider-off safety baseline
gates.pass_when: all provider modes are off/sink; network trace contains zero third-party/provider/BNA requests; no production linkage or real user/row/charge/send

gates.name: PostgreSQL 16 fresh and upgrade
gates.pass_when: fresh schema and supported upgrade path both migrate/verify on isolated PostgreSQL 16 with checksums and no runtime schema creation

gates.name: Family signup transaction and idempotency
gates.pass_when: Family flow creates one contact/lead/audit/outbox set; concurrent/replayed same request is one logical write; different payload conflicts

gates.name: Owner/admin activation, login, dashboard, CRM
gates.pass_when: owner and administrator journeys pass with session rotation, role boundaries, dashboard, CRM list/search/filter/detail/edit/tags/notes/relationships/communications/tasks

gates.name: Household, parent, learners, fourth-seat denial
gates.pass_when: provider-off synthetic subscription and parent activation succeed; exactly three named learners exist; fourth active seat is denied atomically

gates.name: Student and parent protected learning
gates.pass_when: parent/student portals expose functional protected next-class, library, review, progress, and rewards with account/household/sibling isolation

gates.name: Question queue and subscriber support receipt
gates.pass_when: durable provider-off question and support receipts are idempotent, audited, owner/admin-visible, and entitlement-scoped

gates.name: School lead-only proof
gates.pass_when: School signup creates one CRM lead/internal alert only and zero subscription, household, classroom, portal, Family message, or support entitlement

gates.name: Exhaustive visible action registry
gates.pass_when: runtime DOM and action registry are a bijection; every visible control has required metadata/evidence and is functional; zero hidden/dead/Coming Soon placeholders

gates.name: Role, state, responsive, and accessibility matrix
gates.pass_when: all seven roles, twelve states, four viewports, keyboard, RTL, reduced motion, 200% reflow, and design consistency pass

gates.name: Queue retry, dead-letter, restart
gates.pass_when: retryable/terminal faults, lease expiry, worker stop/restart, deterministic retry, dead-letter, and duplicate suppression are proven on PostgreSQL 16

gates.name: Health, scans, budgets, and no BNA fanout
gates.pass_when: web/worker health pass; secret/PII/provider-URL scans pass; request/bundle/database budgets and 30-sample throttled-mobile p50/p75/p95 pass; BNA fanout is zero

gates.name: Logout, revocation, and session isolation
gates.pass_when: logout and parent revocation invalidate intended sessions, token replay fails, role switch clears protected state, and unrelated sessions remain correct

gates.name: Synthetic reset and rollback
gates.pass_when: reset removes/returns every OPS-06 fixture, queue item, session, artifact, cache, and lease to baseline; second reset is also clean

gates.name: Evidence completeness and checksums
gates.pass_when: FINAL-REPORT validates against evidence.schema.json, every evidence file is indexed and checksummed, all gates pass, and blockers is empty
